author: the owner — a real household member, who wrote neither the extractor, its prompt, nor the corpus
cast: Real given names replaced by the corpus cast: the owner -> Alex, the second member -> Robin.

withheld.reason: Two chore sentences describing the owner's child's bath and bedtime are withheld from this repository (owner decision, 2026-09-07). A substituted name does not make a real child's routine fit to publish. Their tallies are recorded below so the verdict's figures stay reproducible even though their text does not ship.

tallies.note: Scored under claude-haiku-4-5 with the owner's rulings, same as every other sentence.
tallies.detail: One was refused for stating no duration, which the owner ruled an honest blank and not a correction. The other was refused where a duration was derivable from the sentence, which the owner ruled a correction of class "refusal".

provenance: cho-1..12 were written COLD — before any feedback, against a brief that explicitly asked for how long each job takes. Every one described cadence instead and none stated a duration. cho-13..21 were written AFTER the session told the owner that durations were missing, so they are COACHED: they exist because the gap was named. Their correction rate is reported separately and weighs less, because a sentence written to fill a field the member has been told about is not a sentence the extractor will meet in the wild.
